message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are visible in the data-acquisition path; the code delegates to Train_Validation/Pred_Validation classes whose implementations are not shown, but no inline validation logic appears in the provided snippets.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is fetched from S3 buckets via S3_Operation without any checksum verification, signed-URL validation, or integrity checks visible in the provided code.
No detected label flipping detection: No code in the pipeline checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation flow calls validation and preprocessing steps but no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering on the training data is visible in the provided code.
No detected model integrity verification: Models are loaded from S3 and MLflow without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision; there is no integrity verification before use.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distribution before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or stress tests are present anywhere in the code.
No detected metric tampering protection: Metrics are retrieved directly from MLflow runs without any signing, hashing, or isolation of a held-out test set from training data to prevent manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The /predict endpoint calls Pred_Validation and prediction_validation() which may do file-level schema checks, but no explicit input shape, range, or Pydantic schema validation is visible in the inference data-flow path shown.

No detected output bounds checks: The predict_from_model() result is converted directly to a JSON string and returned in the response with no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validation visible in the code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular wafer-fault classification pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
